definition_en: (Triple emphatic). Focuses on the listener's use of healthy, balanced logic that everyone would agree with.
example_ar: قَرِّرْ بِمَحْضِ تَقْدِيرِكَ العَقْلِيِّ السَّلِيمِ.
example_en: Decide at your own sound rational discretion.

en: in case financial clarification is requested
fr: en cas de demande de clarification financière
ur: مالی وضاحت طلب ہونے کی صورت میں
definition_en: Conditional phrase providing instructions for when an auditor or accountant needs the money trail explained further.
example_ar: أَرْسِلِ الفَوَاتِيرَ فِي حَالِ طَلَبِ التَّوْضِيحِ المَالِيِّ.
example_en: Send the invoices in case financial clarification is requested.
related: إِذَا سَأَلُوا عَنِ الحِسَابَاتِ, لِلشَّرْحِ النَّقْدِيِّ

en: over completely broken generations
fr: au fil des générations complètement brisées
ur: مکمل طور پر ٹوٹی ہوئی (شکست خوردہ) نسلوں کے دوران
definition_en: Temporal phrase used to describe a continuity of people whose spirit, pride, or society has been crushed by long-term oppression or repeated defeat.
example_ar: نُسِيَتِ العِزَّةُ عَلَى مَدَى الأَجْيَالِ المُنْكَسِرَةِ تَمَامًا.
example_en: Glory was forgotten over completely broken generations.

en: for the purpose of recruitment / for conscription
fr: à des fins de recrutement / pour conscription
ur: بھرتی (فوج میں بھرتی) کی غرض سے
definition_en: Phrase used when an action is taken to gather new members for an army, a company, or a movement.
example_ar: فُتِحَ المَكْتَبُ بِغَرَضِ التَّجْنِيدِ.
example_en: The office was opened for the purpose of recruitment.

en: in the thirtieth place / thirtiethly
fr: en trentième lieu
ur: تیسویں نمبر پر
definition_en: Phrase used to introduce the thirtieth item in an ordered list of points or reasons.
example_ar: وَفِي المَقَامِ الثَّلَاثِينَ، التَّعَاوُنُ الدَّوْلِيُّ.
example_en: And thirtiethly, international cooperation.

front: بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلتَّدَهْوُرِ المَنَاخِيِّ
normalized_front: بما لا يدع مجالا للتدهور المناخي
en: environmentally stable / leaving no room for climate deterioration
fr: écologiquement stable / ne laissant aucune place à la détérioration climatique
ur: جس میں ماحولیاتی بگاڑ کی کوئی گنجائش نہ ہو
definition_en: Phrase used to describe an ecological policy or a technological solution so advanced it stops nature from breaking down further.
example_ar: نَعْمَلُ بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلتَّدَهْوُرِ المَنَاخِيِّ.
example_en: We work leaving no room for climate deterioration.

en: for the sake of promising investment interest
fr: par intérêt d'investissement prometteur
ur: امید افزا سرمایہ کاری کے مفاد کی خاطر
definition_en: Phrase used to justify an action as being motivated by the chance of getting a high financial return in the future.
example_ar: اِشْتَرَيْنَا الأَرْضَ مِنْ قُبَيْلِ المَصْلَحَةِ الاِسْتِثْمَارِيَّةِ الوَاعِدَةِ.
example_en: We bought the land for the sake of promising investment interest.

en: hard to bear his/its absence / deeply missed
fr: difficile de supporter son absence / manque cruellement
ur: جس کی کمی (غیر موجودگی) برداشت کرنا مشکل ہو
definition_en: Phrase used for a beloved person or a vital resource that has gone, leaving a painful gap in life or work.
example_ar: كَانَ الصَّدِيقُ غَالِيًا وَمِنَ الصَّعْبِ تَحَمُّلُ غِيَابِهِ.
example_en: The friend was dear and it was hard to bear his absence.

en: at this mysterious and pivotal stage
fr: à cette phase charnière mystérieuse
ur: اس پراسرار اور کلیدی مرحلے پر
definition_en: Phrase focusing on a turning point where it is not yet clear what the final outcome will be.
example_ar: نَحْنُ نَتَحَرَّكُ فِي هَذِهِ المَرْحَلَةِ المِفْصَلِيَّةِ الغَامِضَةِ.
example_en: We are moving at this mysterious and pivotal stage.

en: without any prior political agreement
fr: sans aucun accord politique préalable
ur: کسی بھی پیشگی سیاسی معاہدے کے بغیر
definition_en: (Double emphatic). Stresses that no deals were made between political parties before an action was taken.
example_ar: اِتُّخِذَ القَرَارُ بِدُونِ سَابِقِ اِتِّفَاقٍ سِيَاسِيٍّ مُسْبَقٍ.
example_en: The decision was made without any prior political agreement.

en: from a theoretical methodological perspective
fr: d'un point de vue méthodologique théorique
ur: نظریاتی اور طریقہ کار کے لحاظ سے
definition_en: Academic phrase narrowing the discussion to the structure of how research or an experiment is built on paper.
example_ar: الخُطَّةُ مُمْتَازَةٌ مِنْ نَاحِيَةٍ مَنْهَجِيَّةٍ نَظَرِيَّةٍ.
example_en: The plan is excellent from a theoretical methodological perspective.

front: بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ الاِعْتِبَارَاتِ الدِّبْلُومَاسِيَّةِ الحَسَّاسَةِ
normalized_front: بغض النظر عن الاعتبارات الدبلوماسية الحساسة
en: regardless of sensitive diplomatic considerations
fr: quelles que soient les considérations diplomatiques sensibles
ur: حساس سفارتی مفادات سے قطع نظر
definition_en: Phrase asserting that an action must be taken even if it offends an ally or causes a major international stir.
example_ar: فَعَلْنَا ذَلِكَ بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ الاِعْتِبَارَاتِ الدِّبْلُومَاسِيَّةِ الحَسَّاسَةِ.
example_en: We did that regardless of sensitive diplomatic considerations.
related: مَهْمَا كَانَ رَدُّ فِعْلِ الدُّوَلِ, لِلْحَقِيقَةِ أَوَّلاً

en: on the verge of a breakthrough / easing of tension
fr: sur le point d'un dénouement / d'une détente
ur: کشادگی (حل) کے قریب
definition_en: Phrase describing a difficult situation or a crisis that is finally starting to clear up and move toward a solution.
example_ar: الأَزْمَةُ عَلَى وَشْكِ الاِنْفِرَاجِ.
example_en: The crisis is on the verge of a breakthrough.

en: at your own purely rational discretion
fr: à ta seule discrétion rationnelle pure
ur: آپ کی اپنی محض عقلی صوابدید پر
definition_en: (Triple emphatic). Focuses entirely on the listener's use of logic, stripping away all social or external pressure.
example_ar: فِكِّرْ بِمَحْضِ تَقْدِيرِكَ العَقْلِيِّ البَحْتِ.
example_en: Think at your own purely rational discretion.

en: in case professional clarification is requested
fr: en cas de demande de clarification professionnelle
ur: پیشہ ورانہ وضاحت طلب ہونے کی صورت میں
definition_en: Conditional phrase providing instructions for when a listener needs the technical and ethical standards of a job explained further.
example_ar: أَنَا هُنَا فِي حَالِ طَلَبِ التَّوْضِيحِ المِهَنِيِّ.
example_en: I am here in case professional clarification is requested.
related: إِذَا سَأَلُوا عَنِ العَمَلِ, لِلشَّرْحِ الفَنِّيِّ

front: عَلَى مَدَى الأَجْيَالِ المُنْبَعِثَةِ مِنْ بَيْنِ الرُّكَامِ
normalized_front: على مدى الأجيال المنبعثة من بين الركام
en: over generations rising / emitting from the rubble
fr: au fil des générations surgissant des décombres
ur: ملبے سے ابھرنے والی نسلوں کے دوران
definition_en: Dramatic temporal phrase used to describe a people who rebuilt their life and society after a total war or natural disaster.
example_ar: بُنِيَتِ المَدِينَةُ عَلَى مَدَى الأَجْيَالِ المُنْبَعِثَةِ مِنْ بَيْنِ الرُّكَامِ.
example_en: The city was built over generations rising from the rubble.

en: for the purpose of liquidation / for filtering / for elimination
fr: à des fins de liquidation / pour filtrage / pour élimination
ur: تصفیہ (خاتمے) کی غرض سے / چھانٹی کے لیے
definition_en: Phrase used when an action is taken to close a company, remove impurities from a liquid, or eliminate political rivals.
example_ar: أُغْلِقَ المَحَلُّ بِغَرَضِ التَّصْفِيَةِ.
example_en: The shop was closed for the purpose of liquidation.

en: in the thirty-first place / thirty-firstly
fr: en trente et unième lieu
ur: اکتیسویں نمبر پر
definition_en: Phrase used to introduce the thirty-first item in an ordered list of points or reasons.
example_ar: وَفِي المَقَامِ الحَادِي وَالثَّلَاثِينَ، التَّقْنِيَّةُ.
example_en: And thirty-firstly, technology.

front: بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلانْقِسَامِ المُجْتَمَعِيِّ
normalized_front: بما لا يدع مجالا للانقسام المجتمعي
en: socially unified / leaving no room for societal division
fr: socialement unifié / ne laissant aucune place à la division sociétale
ur: جس میں سماجی تقسیم (تفریق) کی کوئی گنجائش نہ ہو
definition_en: Phrase used to describe a national identity or a law so strong it prevents people from splitting into fighting groups based on class or tribe.
example_ar: اِتَّحَدْنَا بِمَا لَا يَدَعُ مَجَالاً لِلانْقِسَامِ المُجْتَمَعِيِّ.
example_en: We united leaving no room for societal division.

en: for the sake of high intelligence interest
fr: par intérêt de renseignement supérieur
ur: اعلیٰ انٹیلیجنس (خفیہ معلومات) کے مفاد کی خاطر
definition_en: Phrase used to justify secret government actions as being necessary for gathering vital security information.
example_ar: السِّرُّ مَحْفُوظٌ مِنْ قُبَيْلِ المَصْلَحَةِ الاِسْتِخْبَارَاتِيَّةِ العَالِيَةِ.
example_en: The secret is kept for the sake of high intelligence interest.

en: hard to overcome this obstacle / difficult hurdle
fr: difficile de franchir cet obstacle / hurdle difficile
ur: اس رکاوٹ کو عبور کرنا مشکل ہو
definition_en: Phrase used for a major challenge, either physical (a mountain) or metaphorical (a legal problem), that stops progress.
example_ar: الخِلافُ كَانَ مِنَ الصَّعْبِ تَجَاوُزُ هَذِهِ العَقَبَةِ.
example_en: The disagreement was hard to overcome (this obstacle).

en: on a sustainable developmental scale
fr: à une échelle de développement durable
ur: پائیدار ترقیاتی سطح پر
definition_en: Phrase describing efforts to build economy and society in a way that lasts for centuries without ruining resources.
example_ar: المَشْرُوعُ يَعْمَلُ عَلَى نِطَاقٍ تَنْمَوِيٍّ مُسْتَدَامٍ.
example_en: The project works on a sustainable developmental scale.

en: at this accelerating and pivotal stage
fr: à cette phase charnière accélérée
ur: اس تیز رفتار اور کلیدی مرحلے پر
definition_en: Phrase focusing on a turning point where changes are happening faster and faster every day.
example_ar: العَالَمُ يَتَغَيَّرُ فِي هَذِهِ المَرْحَلَةِ المِفْصَلِيَّةِ المُتَسَارِعَةِ.
example_en: The world is changing at this accelerating and pivotal stage.

en: without prior psychological preparation
fr: sans préparation psychologique préalable
ur: کسی پیشگی نفسیاتی تیاری کے بغیر
definition_en: Phrase used when someone is hit with shocking news or a difficult task without being mentally ready for it first.
example_ar: وَاجَهَ المَشْقَةَ بِدُونِ سَابِقِ تَهْيِئَةٍ نَفْسِيَّةٍ.
example_en: He faced the hardship without prior psychological preparation.

en: from an extremely purely operational perspective
fr: d'un point de vue extrêmement purement opérationnel
ur: انتہائی خالص انتظامی (عملی) لحاظ سے
definition_en: (Triple emphatic). Narrowing the discussion strictly to the smallest details of how a task is performed, ignoring all else.
example_ar: القَرَارُ صَعْبٌ مِنْ نَاحِيَةٍ تَنْفِيذِيَّةٍ بَحْتَةٍ لِلْغَايَةِ.
example_en: The decision is hard from an extremely purely operational perspective.

front: بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ الاِعْتِبَارَاتِ العَقَائِدِيَّةِ الصَّارِمَةِ
normalized_front: بغض النظر عن الاعتبارات العقائدية الصارمة
en: regardless of strict ideological / dogmatic considerations
fr: quelles que soient les considérations idéologiques strictes
ur: سخت نظریاتی (عقائدی) مفادات سے قطع نظر
definition_en: Phrase asserting that a decision is practical and realistic, ignoring the fixed rules of a political or religious dogma.
example_ar: نَتَعَاوَنُ بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ الاِعْتِبَارَاتِ العَقَائِدِيَّةِ الصَّارِمَةِ.
example_en: We cooperate regardless of strict ideological considerations.

en: on the verge of melting down / fusion
fr: sur le point de la fusion / de la fonte
ur: پگھلنے (انصہار) کے دہانے پر
definition_en: Phrase describing a metal being heated to liquid or, figuratively, a nuclear reactor or a person's brain under extreme stress.
example_ar: المَعْدَنُ عَلَى وَشْكِ الانْصِهَارِ.
example_en: The metal is on the verge of melting.

en: at your own realistic logical discretion
fr: à ta seule discrétion logique réaliste
ur: آپ کی اپنی حقیقت پسندانہ منطقی صوابدید پر
definition_en: (Triple emphatic). Combines pure logic with an understanding of how the world actually works (realism).
example_ar: اِخْتَرْ بِمَحْضِ تَقْدِيرِكَ المَنْطِقِيِّ الوَاقِعِيِّ.
example_en: Choose at your own realistic logical discretion.

en: in case procedural clarification is requested
fr: en cas de demande de clarification procédurale
ur: طریقہ کار (پروسیس) کی وضاحت طلب ہونے کی صورت میں
definition_en: Conditional phrase providing instructions for when a listener needs the step-by-step rules of a process explained further.
example_ar: نَحْنُ جَاهِزُونَ فِي حَالِ طَلَبِ التَّوْضِيحِ الإِجْرَائِيِّ.
example_en: We are ready in case procedural clarification is requested.
related: إِذَا سَأَلُوا كَيْفَ نَعْمَلُ, لِلشَّرْحِ الخُطْوِيِّ

front: عَلَى مَدَى الأَجْيَالِ المُنْطَفِئَةِ لِلأَسَفِ الشَّدِيدِ
normalized_front: على مدى الأجيال المنطفئة للأسف الشديد
en: over very unfortunately extinguished generations
fr: au fil des générations très malheureusement éteintes
ur: انتہائی افسوس کے ساتھ بجھی ہوئی نسلوں کے دوران
definition_en: (Double emphatic). A deeply tragic temporal phrase describing people whose legacy and existence have been totally wiped out by history.
example_ar: اِنْدَثَرَ العِلْمُ عَلَى مَدَى الأَجْيَالِ المُنْطَفِئَةِ لِلأَسَفِ الشَّدِيدِ.
example_en: Knowledge disappeared over very unfortunately extinguished generations.

en: for the purpose of receiving / for taking delivery
fr: à des fins de réception / pour prise de livraison
ur: وصولی (ڈلیوری لینے) کی غرض سے
definition_en: Phrase used when an action is taken to pick up a package, a payment, or a building that has been finished.
example_ar: حَضَرَ الوَكِيلُ بِغَرَضِ الاِسْتِلَامِ.
example_en: The agent arrived for the purpose of receiving.

en: in the thirty-second place / thirty-secondly
fr: en trente-deuxième lieu
ur: بتیسویں نمبر پر
definition_en: Phrase used to introduce the thirty-second item in an ordered list of points or reasons.
example_ar: وَفِي المَقَامِ الثَّانِي وَالثَّلَاثِينَ، الشَّفَافِيَّةُ.
example_en: And thirty-secondly, transparency.

en: for the sake of pure professional interest
fr: par intérêt professionnel pur
ur: خالص پیشہ ورانہ مفاد کی خاطر
definition_en: Phrase used to justify an action as being motivated entirely by the rules and ethics of a job, with no personal feelings involved.
example_ar: نَصَحْتُهُ مِنْ قُبَيْلِ المَصْلَحَةِ المِهَنِيَّةِ النَّقِيَّةِ.
example_en: I advised him for the sake of pure professional interest.

en: hard to avoid side effects / inevitable consequences
fr: difficile d'éviter les effets secondaires / conséquences inévitables
ur: جس کے ضمنی اثرات (سائیڈ ایفیکٹس) سے بچنا مشکل ہو
definition_en: Phrase used in medicine, economics, or politics when a necessary action will definitely cause some smaller, unwanted problems.
example_ar: مِنَ الصَّعْبِ تَفَادِي الآثَارِ الجَانِبِيَّةِ لِهَذَا الدَّوَاءِ.
example_en: It is hard to avoid the side effects of this medicine.

en: on a competitive global commercial scale
fr: à une échelle commerciale mondiale compétitive
ur: عالمی تجارتی مسابقتی سطح پر
definition_en: Phrase describing a business or product that is built to fight for market share against the biggest companies in the world.
example_ar: نُنْتِجُ عَلَى نِطَاقٍ تِجَارِيٍّ عَالَمِيٍّ مُنَافِسٍ.
example_en: We produce on a competitive global commercial scale.

en: at this harsh and pivotal stage
fr: à cette phase charnière rude
ur: اس سخت اور کلیدی مرحلے پر
definition_en: Phrase focusing on a turning point in time that is extremely difficult, painful, or testing for everyone involved.
example_ar: اِصْبِرُوا فِي هَذِهِ المَرْحَلَةِ المِفْصَلِيَّةِ القَاسِيَةِ.
example_en: Be patient at this harsh and pivotal stage.

en: without any prior documented financial commitment
fr: sans aucun engagement financier documenté préalable
ur: کسی بھی پیشگی دستاویزی مالی عہد (کمٹمنٹ) کے بغیر
definition_en: (Double emphatic). Stresses that no money was promised or signed for before an action was taken.
example_ar: بَدَأَ المَشْرُوعُ بِدُونِ سَابِقِ تَعَهُّدٍ مَالِيٍّ مُوَثَّقٍ.
example_en: The project started without any prior documented financial commitment.

en: from a precise technical and technological perspective
fr: d'un point de vue technique et technologique précis
ur: دقیق فنی اور تکنیکی لحاظ سے
definition_en: Phrase narrowing the discussion strictly to the mechanics, code, or engineering of how something works.
example_ar: السِّيَّارَةُ مُمْتَازَةٌ مِنْ نَاحِيَةٍ فَنِّيَّةٍ تَقْنِيَّةٍ دَقِيقَةٍ.
example_en: The car is excellent from a precise technical and technological perspective.

front: بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ الاِعْتِبَارَاتِ النَّفْسِيَّةِ العَابِرَةِ
normalized_front: بغض النظر عن الاعتبارات النفسية العابرة
en: regardless of fleeting psychological considerations
fr: quelles que soient les considérations psychologiques éphémères
ur: عارضی نفسیاتی مفادات سے قطع نظر
definition_en: Phrase asserting that a decision ignores short-term feelings like fear or excitement, focusing on long-term facts.
example_ar: قَرِّرْ بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنِ الاِعْتِبَارَاتِ النَّفْسِيَّةِ العَابِرَةِ.
example_en: Decide regardless of fleeting psychological considerations.

en: on the verge of radical / fundamental transformation
fr: sur le point d'une transformation radicale
ur: بنیادی (جڑ سے) تبدیلی کے دہانے پر
definition_en: Phrase describing a situation that is about to change so completely that its original form will be unrecognizable.
example_ar: التِّكْنُولُوجِيَا عَلَى وَشْكِ التَّحَوُّلِ الجِذْرِيِّ.
example_en: Technology is on the verge of radical transformation.

en: at your own purely scientific discretion
fr: à ta seule discrétion scientifique pure
